name: Artifact Search (deterministic catalog + typed-record memory substrate + hybrid lexical retrieval)
purpose: The Collective Agent's authoritative catalog + memory-record substrate (D-0080 Wave 1/2, arch position 23), built to the FROZEN MEMORY_CONTRACT (D-0083). A stdlib-only Python worker (artifact_search.py) owns a SQLite database (sources / documents / document_versions / chunks + records / record_edges + vectors + FTS5) with full provenance. 0.2 adopts the MEMORY_CONTRACT s1 record+provenance ENVELOPE, adds the generic 'ingest_records' SINK so Wave-2 producers (repo.intel #38, episode.memory #39) can land TYPED records (symbol/relationship/episode/failure/summary/...) not chunks, and forward-migrates a shipped-0.1 db in place. Ops: 'ingest' walks a root, content-hashes an inventory, detects new/changed/moved/deleted, chunks Markdown structurally (headings/sections/code-fence-aware) with a generic-text fallback, indexes chunk text in SQLite FTS5, mock-embeds new/changed chunks as float32 LE BLOB vectors keyed on embedding_space_id (the D-0077 seam; the real adapter #35 drops in at fold), reconciles with NO duplicate chunks, serves an EXPLICIT stale fallback when a changed source fails to parse, tombstones deletions, runs a DB integrity check, and emits a deterministic catalog_digest (extended to cover records + edges). 'ingest-records' is the s1 typed-record SINK: deterministic + idempotent, validates ids/required fields, rejects malformed records with a surfaced reason, materializes first-class parent/child edges. 'search' (retriever 0.2 + A4, #37/#40 consume) returns ranked, provenance-complete hits across chunks AND records in DETERMINISTIC order (stable tie_break_key): span object {start,end} + span_label, record_id/record_version_id/record_kind, currentness/status + authority_level, and PER-CHANNEL diagnostics (lexical/vector/fused rank+score, fusion_algo/version, embedding_space_id, index_snapshot, filter_decisions); the opaque single 'score' is RETIRED. 0.3 realizes MEMORY_CONTRACT Amendment A4 (D-0092, Tier-0 seams, ADDITIVE + backward-compatible): filters.namespace is a HARD retrieval boundary (a single value OR an explicit set) enforced BEFORE ranking with an all-hits-match assertion (a cross-namespace hit is a fail-closed 'namespace_leak', never a low-ranked hit); a current_only retrieval MODE (filters.mode=current_only, top-level mode=current_only, or the exclude_stale/current_only aliases) HARD-EXCLUDES any non-'current' record; the CLOSED record_kind enum RESERVES 'node' (the navigation/hierarchy seam) + 'working' (a per-task_id working-memory record, content_role!=evidence, EXCLUDED from ordinary retrieval unless the request scopes to its task_id) and the edge set RESERVES member_of_node/child_of_node/contradicts -- all admitted ADDITIVELY via a schema_version 2->3 in-place migration (a records.task_id/content_role column) that rewrites NONE of the sources/documents/document_versions/chunks tables (NO tree/store/detection built at Tier 0). 'list-records' exposes the s1 record ENVELOPE (source_chunk via a view/adapter + typed records; working records task-scoped). 'migrate' forward-migrates a 0.1/0.2 db to schema_version 3 in place (1->2->3, version-chained, idempotent). 'embed' returns the mock embedding envelope; 'integrity' runs PRAGMA integrity_check + catalog invariants; 'catalog' returns catalog_digest + counts; 'export-chunk-texts' / 'store-embeddings' / 'get-vector' are the fold drop-in (export ordered chunk texts -> real adapter -> store float32 BLOB vectors by chunk_id -> round-trip). Determinism: chunk/document/version ids are content+path derived; the s1 chunk_occurrence_id derives ONLY from immutable inputs (document_version_id + chunker_fingerprint + span + chunk_content_hash), never insertion order; identical corpus+records content yields an identical catalog_digest across runs AND machines; the SQLite file itself is NOT byte-reproducible. CPU-only, no model, no network, NO vector index/ANN and NO real embeddings this wave -> determinism=deterministic, confidence=null, empty model_provenance. Non-goals (NOT built): a vector index/ANN/vector search, real embeddings (#35), #38 parsers / #39 schemas, model summaries, context compiler, UI, web search; and (A4 Tier-0) the bounded-fanout tree / node-synopsis generation / shortlist-and-descend, the working-memory STORE lifecycle, contradiction DETECTION, and the query-classification stage (#37/#40) -- the kinds/edges/seams are RESERVED here, not built. 0.4 realizes MEMORY_CONTRACT Amendment A5 (D-0096, i33 Tier-0 NAMESPACE-CLOSURE + SUPERSESSION-HARDENING; ADDITIVE + backward-compatible): #36 is the retriever/catalog ENFORCEMENT POINT. (U1') namespace is an end-to-end information-flow boundary -- ONE canonical predicate ns_permitted(candidate_ns, effective_allowed) (the A5 mirror of #37's canonical, byte-identical accept/reject) is enforced at EVERY retrieval stage AND every graph hop (the superseded_by chain walk; the list-records edge walk), and EVERY returned/reachable object is scope-checked; a cross-namespace candidate is EXCLUDED before ranking and leaves NO identifying metadata -- only a namespace_violation_count surfaces while identifying detail goes to a PRIVILEGED local security_log (a DB table + an append-only file, NEVER returned); a returned hit outside the effective set is a fail-closed 'namespace_leak' ABORT; a persisted DERIVED/aggregate/node record whose provenance spans >1 namespace is REJECTED at ingest ('cross_namespace_derivation'); effective_allowed is CALLER-SUPPLIED (absent = unscoped back-compat; an explicit EMPTY set = zero hits; NO implicit all/wildcard/prefix/parent). (U4') candidate-INDEPENDENT supersession: a NEW s5 'superseded' status + first-class 'superseded_by'/'supersedes' edges; effective_current(record) is computed from the CATALOG/graph (status==current AND no reachable live in-scope successor at the snapshot), so current_only EXCLUDES a predecessor EVEN WHEN its successor is absent from the returned pool; chain invariants hold (acyclic; canonical direction; NO cross-namespace supersession; a branch of >=2 live successors is FLAGGED conflicted, never a silent pick). (U2') retriever hit provenance fields are CONDITIONAL on provenance_mode (direct_span | derived_record | aggregate | tombstone) and RESERVE candidate_role (navigation|evidence) + retrieval-stage lineage (retrieval_stage_id/parent_stage_id/retrieval_plan_id). (U3') the 'working' kind reserves the working-STORE fields (working_state_id/state_version/parent_state_version/namespace_scope/grant_snapshot_ref/created_from_packet_id/lifecycle_state/writer_authority; NO store lifecycle built) and ordinary 'search' REJECTS record_kind=working by default -- retrievable ONLY by a CONJUNCTIVE op (exact task_id AND an in-scope namespace authorization). All admitted via a schema_version 3->4 in-place migration (records gains the provenance_mode + working-store columns; a new privileged security_log table) that rewrites NONE of the sources/documents/document_versions/chunks tables. Non-goals unchanged (no tree/node-synopsis/shortlist-and-descend, no working-STORE lifecycle/promotion, no contradiction DETECTION, no query classifier -- those are #37/#40 or a later tier).

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Op ingest|ingest-records|list-records|migrate|search|embed|integrity|catalog|export-chunk-texts|store-embeddings|get-vector (default search); -Query <string> (search); -Text <string> (embed single); -Source <label>; -Root <dir> (ingest); -DbPath <path> (default runtime/catalog/artifact_search.db); -Mode fts|exact (default fts); -K <int, default 10>; -Dim <int, default 64>; -Normalize:$true|$false (default true); -MaxFiles <int budget>; -MaxChunkChars <int, default 4000>; -EmbedProvider mock|none; -Limit <int>; -TargetKind chunk|record; -TargetId <id> (get-vector); -PythonPath <python>; -WorkerPath <artifact_search.py>. OR the generic -InputsJson '<json {op, query, text, texts[], source, root, db, mode, k, dim, normalize, max_files, max_chunk_chars, embed_provider, include[], exclude[], exclude_dirs[], filters{source,namespace,type,path_prefix,content_hash,record_kind,status,exclude_stale}, records[<s1 envelope record>], ingest_run{producer,producer_version,namespace,repo_commit,worktree_dirty}, limit, chunk_ids[], vectors[][], provider_id, embedding_space_id, model_id, model_version, model_sha256, engine_build, target_kind, target_id, python_path}>' (named params override matching keys). ingest-records/migrate create-or-open the db (no pre-existing db required); other db-ops require an existing db. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: ingest|ingest-records|list-records|migrate|search|embed|integrity|catalog|export-chunk-texts|store-embeddings|get-vector.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: search: the query text (fts tokens AND-ed; exact = literal substring over chunk/record text + filename).

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: embed: a single text (alternative to texts[]).

inputs.name: texts
inputs.description: embed: a batch of texts; vectors align 1:1 in EXACT input order.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: ingest: a stable source label (slugged to source_id; the logical corpus identity, machine-independent). search/filters: restrict to this source.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: ingest: the directory root to walk.

inputs.name: db
inputs.description: the SQLite catalog path (created by ingest/ingest-records/migrate; required to exist for other db-ops).

inputs.name: records
inputs.description: ingest-records: an array of MEMORY_CONTRACT s1 envelope records to land as TYPED records (record_id, record_version_id, record_kind, namespace, text|content_hash, source_version_id?, source_span?, status?, authority_level?, sensitivity_class?, derivation_refs?, parser/chunker/extractor_fingerprint?, token_count?, embedding_space_id?, section_path?, heading?, title?, attrs?, edges[]?).

inputs.name: ingest_run
inputs.description: ingest-records: the ingest-run header {producer, producer_version, namespace, repo_commit, worktree_dirty}.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: search: the LEXICAL backend fts (SQLite FTS5) | exact (literal substring). A4: may also be current_only (a compat shim for the retriever temporal mode -> lexical backend defaults to fts); the canonical temporal mode is filters.mode.

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: search: max results.

inputs.name: dim
inputs.description: embedding dimension (mock provider / ingest embed / store-embeddings).

inputs.name: normalize
inputs.description: L2-normalize embedding vectors.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.description: search/list-records: {source, namespace (A4: a HARD boundary -- a single value OR an explicit set/array; enforced before ranking with an all-hits-match assertion), mode (A4 temporal: current_only hard-excludes non-'current'), current_only (bool alias), task_id (A4: working-memory scope -- surfaces a 'working' record only for its own task_id), type (chunk_type), path_prefix (rel_path prefix), content_hash, record_kind, status/currentness, exclude_stale}.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: list-records/export-chunk-texts: max rows (0 = no cap).

inputs.name: max_files
inputs.description: ingest: file budget (0 = no cap); a hit is surfaced as a warning + report.file_budget_hit.

inputs.name: max_chunk_chars
inputs.description: ingest: soft chunk size target (split at blank lines, never inside a code fence). Part of chunker_fingerprint: a change re-derives chunks even when the source hash is unchanged.

inputs.name: embed_provider
inputs.description: ingest: mock (deterministic hashed pseudo-vectors, float32 BLOB) | none (lexical only).

inputs.name: include
inputs.description: ingest: optional include globs on rel_path/filename (default: all text-like).

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: ingest: exclude globs on rel_path/filename (default: *.db etc.).

inputs.name: chunk_ids
inputs.description: store-embeddings: target ids (chunk_id | record_version_id) aligned 1:1 with vectors[].

inputs.name: vectors
inputs.description: store-embeddings: externally-produced vectors (fold drop-in for the real adapter #35); stored as float32 LE BLOB keyed on embedding_space_id.

inputs.name: embedding_space_id
inputs.description: store-embeddings/get-vector: the immutable vector-space id (else derived from provider/model/dim/normalized).

inputs.name: target_kind
inputs.description: store-embeddings/get-vector: chunk | record.

inputs.name: target_id
inputs.description: get-vector: the chunk_id or record_version_id to round-trip.

outputs.description: envelope.result = { op, result:<op payload>, worker, runtime_ms }. ingest -> { source_id, root, run_id, counts{seen,added,changed,deleted,unchanged,parse_failures,moved,stale_fallbacks,records_marked_source_stale}, added[], changed[], deleted[], moved[{from,to}], parse_failures[{rel_path,reason,detail}], stale_fallbacks[], chunker_fingerprint, schema_version, catalog_digest, integrity{ok,checks[]}, integrity_ok, counts_total, db }. ingest-records -> { run_id, producer, counts{received,accepted,unchanged,rejected,kinds{}}, accepted[], unchanged[], rejected[{record_version_id,reason,detail}], integrity{ok,checks[]}, integrity_ok, catalog_digest, schema_version, counts_total, db }. list-records -> { count, records[<s1 envelope: record_id, record_version_id, record_kind, namespace, content_hash, status, authority_level, sensitivity_class, valid_from, valid_to, created_by_ingest_run, source_version_id, source_path, source_span{start,end}, derivation_refs, parser/chunker/extractor_fingerprint, schema_version, token_count, embedding_space_id, section_path, heading, title, chunk_type, attrs, task_id, content_role, parent_edges[], child_edges[]>], counts_total, db }. migrate -> { db, schema_version, target_schema_version, migration_actions[], migrated, counts, integrity, catalog_digest, shipped_tables_schema_sha (A4: sha256 of the four shipped tables' CREATE sql -- unchanged by the 2->3 migration) }. search -> { query, mode, k, count, filters, corpus_version, fusion_algo, fusion_version, retrieval_channels[], results[{ record_id, record_version_id, record_kind, chunk_id, source_path, abs_path, content_hash, chunk_content_hash, span{start,end}, span_label, section_path, heading, chunk_type, status, currentness, authority_level, namespace, source, source_version_id, embedding_space_id, retrieval_channels[], lexical_rank, lexical_score, vector_rank, vector_similarity, fused_rank, fused_score, fusion_algo, fusion_version, index_snapshot, corpus_version, filter_decisions, tie_break_key, snippet, rank }], db }. embed -> { provider_id, model_id, model_version, model_sha256, engine_build, embedding_space_id, dim, normalized, count, input_count, vector_count, failed_count, encoding_version, vectors[[...]], input_status[{index,status,chars?}] }. integrity -> { ok, checks[{name,ok,detail}], schema_version, counts, db }. catalog -> { db, schema_version, digest, counts, shipped_tables_schema_sha }. export-chunk-texts -> { count, chunks[{chunk_id, rel_path, content_hash, chunk_content_hash, chunk_occurrence_id, chunker_fingerprint, span, text}], db }. store-embeddings -> { stored, requested, skipped_unknown_target, provider_id, dim, embedding_space_id, encoding_version, target_kind }. get-vector -> { vector{embedding_space_id, dim, encoding_version, vector_bytes, normalized, vector_sha256, vector[]}, db }.
